description:
Research position overview

This project develops CRISPR-Cas tools to limit the spread of antimicrobial resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae. The work focuses on resistance-carrying plasmids and combines microbiology, genomics and synthetic biology to examine how resistance genes move between bacteria.

Research Areas

  • Microbiology
  • CRISPR-Cas
  • Antimicrobial resistance

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryGBP 21,805/year (2026/27 reference rate)
DurationFour years
TuitionUK and international tuition covered under the GW4 BioMed competition

Research training and support funding of up to GBP 5,000 per year is advertised. Visa, healthcare surcharge and relocation costs remain the international student’s responsibility.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Academic preparationFirst or upper second-class honours degree, or international equivalent; a lower second-class degree requires a suitable master’s.
Further conditionsUK and international tuition covered; international cohort cap applies.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round21 October 2026, 17:00 BST
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Exeter

Exeter offers postgraduate research across health, life sciences, economics and environmental disciplines. Its GW4 BioMed projects combine supervision at the university with research training across the regional partnership.
